## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Risk

- [ ] No money movement, settlement, ledger, signing, authentication, migration, or public-contract behavior changes.
- [ ] Financial/security-sensitive behavior changed and the relevant invariants, replay, concurrency, and negative tests are included.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, unit tests, type checks, and builds relevant to this change pass.
- [ ] Database changes include forward/down/static tests and live PostgreSQL evidence where required.
- [ ] Public API/event changes update OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, SDKs, examples, and compatibility tests.
- [ ] User-facing copy is localized in EN, zh-CN, ES, FR, DE, and RU.
- [ ] Deployment changes preserve fail-closed defaults and update release-admission evidence.
